<module id="adder_pipe_64bit">
    <description>64-bit Ripple Carry Adder with pipelining and output enable.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock input.</input>
        <input id="rst_n">Active low reset signal.</input>
        <input id="i_en">Enable signal for addition operation.</input>
        <input id="adda" width_description="[63:0]">64-bit input operand A.</input>
        <input id="addb" width_description="[63:0]">64-bit input operand B.</input>
        <output id="result" width_description="[64:0]">65-bit output representing the sum of adda and addb.</output>
        <output id="o_en">Output enable signal indicating the availability of the result.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description/>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic"/>
    <implementation>
        // Pipeline registers
        reg [63:0] adda_reg;
        reg [63:0] addb_reg;
        reg [63:0] sum_reg;
        reg o_en_reg;

        // Full adder function
        function [1:0] full_adder;
            input [1:0] a, b, cin;
            begin
                full_adder[0] = a ^ b ^ cin;
                full_adder[1] = (a & b) | (b & cin) | (a & cin);
            end
        endfunction

        // Always block for pipeline stages
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (!rst_n) begin
                adda_reg <= 64'd0;
                addb_reg <= 64'd0;
                sum_reg <= 64'd0;
                o_en_reg <= 1'b0;
            end else begin
                if (i_en) begin
                    adda_reg <= adda;
                    addb_reg <= addb;
                end
                sum_reg <= adda_reg + addb_reg;
                o_en_reg <= i_en;
            end
        end

        // Assign outputs
        assign result = {sum_reg[63], sum_reg};
        assign o_en = o_en_reg;
    </implementation>
</module>
